contexts.text: Those who believe a thing to be true because it has been declared to be so by a man of authority, are represented by magpies.
Another of the gods turned the virgins of Parnassus into magpies.
Magpies (when mentioned in the Word, are one of the kinds of birds which signify falsities).
Magpies (are birds of an intermediate character which appear in the World of Spirits).
